name: tpl-not-co-existence-2-nogoal
task: Never both drop the key while the door is still closed and open the door.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: NotCoExistence(key_lost, door_open) treats key_lost as a one-step drop event, but the task forbids dropping the key while the door is closed; it does not forbid opening the door after such a drop. The clause rejects that sequence permanently. Use Absence(key_lost) to forbid the specified drop event.

CHANGES REQUIRED: The task says never both drop the key while the door is closed and open the door. Absence(key_lost) forbids dropping the key while the door is closed, even if the door is never opened. Replace it with hard NotCoExistence(key_lost, door_open), which forbids the two events from both occurring during the episode.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: hard NotCoExistence(key_lost, door_open) captures the task’s requirement that dropping the key while the door is closed and opening the door never both happen during the episode. The rule-only warning is valid; the task requires no goal.

texts: Never both drop the key while the door is closed and open the door during the episode.
